### Method Bodies (implement exactly as specified)

#### `Execute` — CYC=6

```csharp
internal static void Execute(Account acc, Instrument instr, bool useAsk, int bufferTicks)
{
    // (1) instr null guard
    if (instr == null) return;

    // (2) Compute exit price — false if no market data
    if (!TryGetExitPrice(instr, useAsk, bufferTicks, out double exitPrice)) return;

    // (3) Position guard — no-op if no open position or zero quantity
    var pos = CopyEngine.Instance.FindPositionPublic(acc, instr);
    if (pos == null || pos.Quantity == 0)
    {
        NinjaTrader.Code.Output.Process("[PTT-MA] no position: " + acc.Name, PrintTo.OutputTab1);
        return;
    }

    // (4) Find Working target — no-op if none (B211-BEHAV-1)
    if (!TryFindWorkingTarget(acc, instr, out var target))
    {
        NinjaTrader.Code.Output.Process("[PTT-MA] no target found for " + acc.Name, PrintTo.OutputTab1);
        return;
    }

    // (5) Partial-fill safe quantity (B211-PARTIAL-FILL P0 MANDATORY)
    int qty = target.Quantity - target.Filled;

    // Determine order name prefix (ternary branch — counted in CYC=6)
    string prefix = useAsk ? PttOrderNames.MaAskPrefix : PttOrderNames.MaBidPrefix;
    string orderName = prefix + System.Threading.Interlocked.Increment(ref _maSeq).ToString("D5");
    bool isLong = pos.MarketPosition == MarketPosition.Long;
    OrderAction action = isLong ? OrderAction.Sell : OrderAction.BuyToCover;

    NinjaTrader.Code.Output.Process(
        "[PTT-MA] " + (useAsk ? "Ask" : "Bid") + ": " + acc.Name
        + " price=" + exitPrice + " qty=" + qty,
        PrintTo.OutputTab1);

    // NT8 API calls — wrapped in try/catch log-and-swallow (V2 spec compliance). JS-001: no rethrow.
    try
    {
        acc.Cancel(new NinjaTrader.Cbi.Order[] { target });
        var newOrder = acc.CreateOrder(
            instr,
            action,
            OrderType.Limit,
            OrderEntry.Manual,
            TimeInForce.Day,
            qty,
            exitPrice,
            0.0,
            string.Empty,
            orderName,
            NinjaTrader.Core.Globals.MaxDate,
            (NinjaTrader.Cbi.CustomOrder)null);   // NT8-007: cast to CustomOrder, not string
        if (newOrder != null) acc.Submit(new[] { newOrder });
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        NinjaTrader.Code.Output.Process("[PTT-MA] Execute exception: " + ex.Message, PrintTo.OutputTab1);
    }
}
```

#### `TryGetExitPrice` — CYC=7

```csharp
internal static bool TryGetExitPrice(Instrument instr, bool useAsk, int bufferTicks, out double price)
{
    // (1) tickSize null-coalescing branch
    double tickSize = instr.MasterInstrument?.TickSize ?? 0.0;
    // (2) tickSize <= 0 guard
    if (tickSize <= 0.0) { price = 0.0; return false; }
    // (3) md == null guard
    var md = instr.MarketData;
    if (md == null) { price = 0.0; return false; }
    // (4) ternary: select Ask or Bid side
    var side = useAsk ? md.Ask : md.Bid;
    // (5) side == null guard
    if (side == null) { price = 0.0; return false; }
    double basePrice = side.Price;
    // (6) basePrice <= 0 guard
    if (basePrice <= 0.0) { price = 0.0; return false; }
    // Price rounded to tick grid
    double raw = basePrice + bufferTicks * tickSize;
    price = Math.Round(raw / tickSize) * tickSize;
    return true;
}
```

CYC count: base(1) + ??(1) + <=0(1) + md==null(1) + useAsk?(1) + side==null(1) + basePrice<=0(1) = **CYC=7**.  
Under global limit of 8. ✓

#### `TryFindWorkingTarget` — CYC=6

```csharp
private static bool TryFindWorkingTarget(Account acc, Instrument instr,
    out NinjaTrader.Cbi.Order target)
{
    target = default(NinjaTrader.Cbi.Order);
    // (1) foreach — iterate snapshot
    foreach (var o in acc.Orders.ToList())
    {
        // (2) instrument FullName + OrderState.Working compound filter
        if (o.Instrument?.FullName != instr.FullName || o.OrderState != OrderState.Working)
            continue;
        // (3) OrderType.Limit filter
        if (o.OrderType != OrderType.Limit) continue;
        // (4) PTT- prefix filter (excludes ATM-managed brackets)
        if (o.Name == null || !o.Name.StartsWith("PTT-", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
        // (5) Exit action filter: Sell (long exit) or BuyToCover (short exit)
        if (o.OrderAction != OrderAction.Sell && o.OrderAction != OrderAction.BuyToCover) continue;
        // Take last match — DW-B211-03: most recently submitted PTT-* exit
        target = o;
    }
    // JS-002: no null returned from method — caller checks bool
    return target != null;
}
```

### Method Body — CYC=3

```csharp
internal static void Execute(Instrument instrument, bool useAsk, int bufferTicks)
{
    // (1) instrument null guard — defense-in-depth (caller already guards, but keep for standalone use)
    if (instrument == null)
    {
        NinjaTrader.Code.Output.Process("[PTT-MA-ALL] instrument null", PrintTo.OutputTab1);
        return;
    }
    // Log without ternary — log bool directly to keep CYC=3
    NinjaTrader.Code.Output.Process(
        "[PTT-MA-ALL] useAsk=" + useAsk + " instr=" + instrument.FullName + " buf=" + bufferTicks + "t",
        PrintTo.OutputTab1);
    // (2) foreach all accounts with position on instrument
    foreach (Account acc in CopyEngine.Instance.AllAccounts(instrument))
    {
        PttMoveTargetOne.Execute(acc, instrument, useAsk, bufferTicks);
    }
}
```

### Required Tests (all 8 mandatory)

| Test Name | What It Asserts |
|-----------|----------------|
| `PttMoveTargetOne_NoTarget_ReturnsNoOp` | When acc has no Working Limit orders matching PTT-* pattern: `acc.CreateOrder` is never called (verified via output capture or spy pattern following B209Tests.cs stub infrastructure). |
| `PttMoveTargetOne_NoPosition_ReturnsNoOp` | When acc has a Working Limit order but no open position (qty==0): `acc.Cancel` is never called. |
| `PttMoveTargetOne_PartialFill_QtyIsQuantityMinusFilled` | Given `target.Quantity=5`, `target.Filled=2`: computed `qty == 3`. |
| `PttMoveTargetOne_ZeroFill_QtyIsQuantity` | Given `target.Quantity=4`, `target.Filled=0`: computed `qty == 4`. |
| `TryGetExitPrice_AskPlusZeroBuffer_ReturnsAskExactly` | Ask=100.0, tickSize=0.25, bufferTicks=0, useAsk=true → `price == 100.0`. |
| `TryGetExitPrice_AskPlusTwoBuffer_ReturnsAskPlusTwoTicks` | Ask=100.0, tickSize=0.25, bufferTicks=2, useAsk=true → `price == 100.5`. |
| `TryGetExitPrice_BidMinusOneBuffer_ReturnsBidMinusOneTick` | Bid=99.75, tickSize=0.25, bufferTicks=-1, useAsk=false → `price == 99.5`. |
| `IsBeSwapGtcSweepGuard_ReturnsFalse_ForPttMaAskOrder` | `CopyEngine.IsBeSwapGtcSweepGuard("PTT-MA-Ask-1", true) == false`. Confirms PTT-MA-* orders are NOT protected by FIX-G-2 and ARE swept by TryCancelSingleStaleGtcExit. This is correct — PTT-MA-* exits must remain moveable during BE swap. |

### Test Engineering Notes

1. **T1/T2 stub pattern**: `PttMoveTargetOne` is a static class that calls `CopyEngine.Instance.FindPositionPublic()` and `acc.Cancel()/CreateOrder()`. Follow the stub/fake Account pattern established in `B209Tests.cs`. If full Account stubbing is impractical with existing infrastructure, test no-op behaviour via `Output.Process` log capture.

2. **T3/T4 pure arithmetic**: These test `qty = target.Quantity - target.Filled`. Use a minimal fake Order stub with only `Quantity` and `Filled` properties set.

3. **T5/T6/T7 access requirement**: `TryGetExitPrice` MUST be declared `internal static` (not `private static`) to be callable from `B211Tests.cs`. See method signature above. Verify `InternalsVisibleTo` is in place for the test project (follow existing pattern in CopyEngine.cs or the test project .csproj).

4. **T8 direct call**: `CopyEngine.IsBeSwapGtcSweepGuard` is a static method — call directly. Confirm it is `internal` and accessible via existing `InternalsVisibleTo` attribute.

```csharp
private void OnAskUp(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    _askBuffer = Math.Max(Math.Min(_askBuffer + 1, 20), -10);
    UpdateAskLabels();
}

private void OnAskDown(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    _askBuffer = Math.Max(Math.Min(_askBuffer - 1, 20), -10);
    UpdateAskLabels();
}

private void OnAskClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    if (_instrument == null) return;
    _leaderAccount = _leaderAccount ?? TryResolveLeaderAccount();
    if (_leaderAccount == null) return;
    PttMoveTargetOne.Execute(_leaderAccount, _instrument, useAsk: true, _askBuffer);
}

private void OnAskAllClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    if (_instrument == null) return;
    PttMoveTargetAll.Execute(_instrument, useAsk: true, _askBuffer);
}

private void OnAskAllUp(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)   => OnAskUp(sender, e);
private void OnAskAllDown(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => OnAskDown(sender, e);

private void UpdateAskLabels()
{
    if (_askBtn    != null) _askBtn.Content    = FormatBuffer("Ask",     _askBuffer);
    if (_askAllBtn != null) _askAllBtn.Content = FormatBuffer("Ask-ALL", _askBuffer);
}

private void OnBidUp(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    _bidBuffer = Math.Max(Math.Min(_bidBuffer + 1, 20), -10);
    UpdateBidLabels();
}

private void OnBidDown(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    _bidBuffer = Math.Max(Math.Min(_bidBuffer - 1, 20), -10);
    UpdateBidLabels();
}

private void OnBidClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    if (_instrument == null) return;
    _leaderAccount = _leaderAccount ?? TryResolveLeaderAccount();
    if (_leaderAccount == null) return;
    PttMoveTargetOne.Execute(_leaderAccount, _instrument, useAsk: false, _bidBuffer);
}

private void OnBidAllClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    if (_instrument == null) return;
    PttMoveTargetAll.Execute(_instrument, useAsk: false, _bidBuffer);
}

private void OnBidAllUp(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)   => OnBidUp(sender, e);
private void OnBidAllDown(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => OnBidDown(sender, e);

private void UpdateBidLabels()
{
    if (_bidBtn    != null) _bidBtn.Content    = FormatBuffer("Bid",     _bidBuffer);
    if (_bidAllBtn != null) _bidAllBtn.Content = FormatBuffer("Bid-ALL", _bidBuffer);
}
```

---

## Threading Model — No Dispatcher.InvokeAsync Needed

All 14 handlers above are called from WPF button/RepeatButton click events — already on the UI thread.  
`_askBuffer`/`_bidBuffer` are `volatile int` — read/write from UI thread only, no inter-thread contention.  
`PttMoveTargetOne.Execute` and `PttMoveTargetAll.Execute` call NT8 AddOnBase API (`acc.Cancel`, `acc.CreateOrder`, `acc.Submit`) — UI-thread-safe.  
**DO NOT add `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync` wrappers** — they are not needed and would introduce unnecessary async execution where synchronous is correct.
